name: 06067 · Rocky Hill, CT
findings: ZIP 06067 (Rocky Hill) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (66%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06067 (Rocky Hill) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06067 (Rocky Hill) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
